label: Where are you in the Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program today?
help: Enrollment is free. Benefits packages are optional purchases. A Solutions Partner designation is earned by score and then purchased.

options.label: Enrolled with a benefits package
options.hint: Partner Launch, Partner Success Core, or Expanded

options.label: Solutions Partner
options.hint: We hold at least one designation

label: Which Solutions Partner designations do you hold?
help: Pick every one that is active in Partner Center. One $4,875 annual fee covers all of them.

label: Which of these specializations do you already hold?
help: Leave all of them unticked if you hold none yet. These are the specializations on the path to Frontier Partner.

label: Which solution area should we score?
help: Pick the designation you are working toward, or the one you hold and want to check for renewal. Each area is scored on its own rules.

options.label: Digital & App Innovation (Azure)
options.hint: App dev, GitHub, Power Platform dev

label: How many net new SMB customer tenants did you add in the last 12 months?
help: Count tenants with 11 to 300 paid licenses on an eligible workload (Microsoft 365 Apps, Exchange, Teams, Intune, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and similar), associated through CSP or a CPOR claim. Net means new minus lost. 2 points each, 20 points at 10.

label: How many people hold an intermediate Modern Work certification?
help: MS-700 (Teams Administrator), MD-102 (Endpoint Administrator), SC-300, MS-721, or Copilot and Agent Administration Fundamentals. Count people, not certificates. 5 points each, 10 points at 2.

label: How many people hold the advanced Modern Work certification?
help: MS-102 (Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert). It retires November 30, 2026, and still counts through November 30, 2027, so sit it before it retires. 15 points for 1 person.

label: How are you mostly associated with your Microsoft 365 customers?
help: Microsoft sets different targets for each association type and scores whichever earns more. CPOR targets are a quarter to a half of the CSP targets.

options.label: Through CPOR claims
options.hint: We claim partner of record on deployments

options.label: Not sure
options.hint: We will score the stricter CSP target

label: How many monthly active users have your SMB customers grown by over the last 12 months?
help: Active users last month minus the same month last year, across eligible workloads, counted only from when you were associated. Full 30 points at 2,000 (CSP) or 500 (CPOR).

label: How many net new customer tenants reached 40% of paid licenses active this year?
help: Tenants that crossed 40% active usage on an eligible workload in the last 12 months. Tenants already above 40% when you claimed them in the last 12 months do not count. 25 points at 10 (CSP) or 5 (CPOR).

label: How many net new Security customers did you add in the last 12 months?
help: Customers with 5 to 300 paid licenses on a security workload (CSP or CPOR), or $600+ security Azure spend over 12 months. 4 points each, 20 points at 5.

label: How many people hold SC-500 (Cloud and AI Security Engineer)?
help: Step 1 gate, worth 4 points. AZ-500 holders who passed before it retired on August 31, 2026 also count for one year.

label: How many people hold SC-200 (Security Operations Analyst)?
help: Step 2 gate, worth 4 points. Step 3 points only count once both gates are met.

label: How many people hold SC-401, SC-300, or SC-100?
help: Step 3: 8 points per person, up to 4 people. SC-401 also counts toward the Copilot and Data Security specializations.

label: How many protected users have your Security customers grown by over the last 12 months?
help: Growth in protected users across eligible security workloads. 1 point per 50 users, 20 points at 1,000. Microsoft also accepts security Azure spend growth (1 point per $750).

label: How many net new security deployments did you add in the last 12 months?
help: Tenants with 5 to 300 licenses where at least 15% of paid licenses are active, or Azure security spend of $750 to $12,000 over 12 months. 20 points at 6.

label: How many net new Azure customers did you add in the last 12 months?
help: Customers with at least $500 Azure consumed revenue in one of the last two months, associated through CSP, DPOR, or Partner Admin Link. 10 points each, 30 points at 3.

label: How many people hold AZ-104 (Azure Administrator)?
help: Mandatory gate, worth 4 points.

label: How many people hold AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect Expert)?
help: Mandatory gate, worth 4 points. Data & AI certification points only count once both gates are met.

label: How many people hold a Data & AI associate certification?
help: DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer), DP-700, DP-300, Data Analyst, AI Apps and Agents Developer, and similar. 4 points per person, up to 8 people. DP-600 also counts toward Frontier Partner.

label: By what percentage did your qualifying Azure consumed revenue grow year over year?
help: Enter a whole percentage. 1 point per 1%, 20 points at 20%. Requires at least $1,000 qualifying revenue over 12 months.

label: How many distinct Azure services had customer spend in the last 12 months?
help: Unique Azure services with consumed revenue above zero. Virtual Machines and VM licenses do not count. 2 points each, 10 points at 5.

label: How many net new Azure customers did you add in the last 12 months?
help: Customers with at least $500 Azure consumed revenue in one of the last two months, associated through CSP, DPOR, or Partner Admin Link. 10 points each, 30 points at 3.

label: How many people hold AZ-104 (Azure Administrator)?
help: Gate for the intermediate metric, worth 4 points.

label: How many people hold an intermediate Digital & App Innovation certification?
help: GitHub Copilot, Power Platform Developer, Azure AI Cloud Developer, and similar. 4 points per person, up to 4, once the AZ-104 gate is met.

label: How many people hold AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect Expert)?
help: Gate for the advanced metric, worth 4 points.

label: How many people hold an advanced Digital & App Innovation certification?
help: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Power Platform Solution Architect Expert, or a GitHub advanced certification. 4 points per person, up to 4, once the AZ-305 gate is met.

label: By what percentage did your qualifying Azure consumed revenue grow year over year?
help: Enter a whole percentage. 1 point per 1%, 20 points at 20%.

label: How many distinct Azure services had customer spend in the last 12 months?
help: Unique Azure services with consumed revenue above zero. Virtual Machines and VM licenses do not count. 2 points each, 10 points at 5.

label: How many net new Azure customers did you add in the last 12 months?
help: Customers with at least $500 Azure consumed revenue in one of the last two months, associated through CSP, DPOR, or Partner Admin Link. 10 points each, 30 points at 3.

label: How many people hold AZ-104 (Azure Administrator)?
help: Gate for the intermediate metric, worth 4 points.

label: How many people hold an intermediate Infrastructure certification?
help: Azure Network Engineer or Windows Server Hybrid Administrator. 4 points per person, up to 4, once the AZ-104 gate is met.

label: How many people hold AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect Expert)?
help: Gate for the advanced metric, worth 4 points.

label: How many people hold an advanced Infrastructure certification?
help: Azure Virtual Desktop Specialty or Azure for SAP Workloads Specialty. 4 points per person, up to 4, once the AZ-305 gate is met.

label: By what percentage did your qualifying Azure consumed revenue grow year over year?
help: Enter a whole percentage. 1 point per 1%, 20 points at 20%.

label: How many distinct Azure services had customer spend in the last 12 months?
help: Unique Azure services with consumed revenue above zero. Virtual Machines and VM licenses do not count. 2 points each, 10 points at 5.

label: How many net new customer workloads did you add in the last 12 months?
help: Dynamics 365 or Power Platform workloads per customer tenant with $250+ revenue in a month. 3 points each, 15 points at 5.

label: How many people hold an intermediate Business Applications certification?
help: Dynamics 365 or Power Platform associate certifications, such as Power Platform Developer or Intelligent Applications Builder. 4 points per person, 20 points at 5.

label: How many people hold an advanced Business Applications certification?
help: AB-100 (Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect) or Business Central Developer. 7.5 points per person, 15 points at 2. AB-100 also counts toward the Copilot specialization.

label: By what percentage did monthly consumption value grow year over year?
help: Enter a whole percentage. 1 point per 1%, 30 points at 30%. Needs a baseline of at least 25,000 monthly consumption value 12 months ago.

label: How many net new workload deployments reached 5,000 monthly consumption value?
help: Workloads per customer tenant at or above 5,000 monthly consumption value. 4 points each, 20 points at 5.

label: What is your number one goal for the next 12 months?
help: This tunes the roadmap. Picking a specialization adds a few readiness questions.

options.label: Earn or renew a Solutions Partner designation

label: How many Microsoft 365 Copilot monthly active users have your customers grown by over the last 12 months?
help: The Copilot specialization needs 1,000 MAU growth across customers associated through CPOR or CSP.

label: How many net new customers have 5 or more Copilot monthly active users each?
help: The specialization needs 5, in addition to the 1,000 MAU growth.

label: How many people hold SC-401 (Information Security Administrator)?
help: The specialization needs 5.

label: How many people hold AB-620 or AB-100?
help: The specialization needs 5 people with an agent certification, in addition to the 5 SC-401 holders. The same person can hold both.

label: How many employees have earned the Frontier Transformation Engineer Titan badge?
help: Earned on Skilling Hub (Level Up) and linked to Partner Center. Frontier Partner needs 5.

label: How many employees hold an active DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate)?
help: Frontier Partner needs 3. The same people can count toward the Titan badge requirement.

label: Do you have a TD SYNNEX Business Development Manager assigned to you?
help: This sets whether the export recommends a direct handoff or a routing request.
